t: Restaurant Review: Creative Meets Classic at Scelto
s: March 27, 2024 - Moving on to the pasta side of things, I was intrigued by the gnocchi ($27) because it's served with a ragu and a sage cream sauce. Typically, you get one or the other when ordering a pasta dish, so I was eager to see how Scelto would pull this off. The plate arrives with a heaping helping of deep red ragu, topped with homemade gnocchi and then dolloped with the sage cream sauce.

t: First Bite: Scelto in Sandy • Salt Lake Magazine
s: May 6, 2024 - I am admittedly a Salt Lake snob, generally adhering to the principle that anything south of 33rd is “the country.” But I was drawn out of my usual stomping grounds recently by talk around town of a new Italian-inspired restaurant called Scelto in, gasp, Sandy.

t: A Matter of Choice: Sandy's New Scelto Restaurant - Utah Stories
s: February 16, 2024 - They include a tempting cacio e pepe pizza ($17), formaggio ($18), carne/pepperoni ($18), blanca ($20) with grilled chicken and goat cheese; settembrina ($19) – fig, prosciutto, arugula & fontina; and fungo wild mushroom pizza ($18). I always think that a Margherita (spelled Margarita on Scelto’s menu) pizza is the best way to judge a pizzaiolo (pizza maker) by, since there’s no place to hide.

t: Sandy's Newest Italian-Inspired Restaurant is Scelto • Salt Lake Magazine
s: August 20, 2024 - No offense to chain restaurants (well, maybe a little), but when it comes to delivering stylish dining to our suburbs, they come up short. Way short. Enter Scelto, a new Italian restaurant in the heart of Utah.
